hooks.comment: Skills auto-activation - suggests relevant skills before Claude sees prompt
Enforce proper tool usage - block file operations in Bash
Enforce restart script usage - block manual server management
Prevent direct commits to main branch
Block emojis in git commits and PR operations
Block development markers (TODO:, FIXME, HACK, etc.) in commits
Prevent AI from merging PRs directly - require user approval
hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command' | grep -qE 'gh pr merge' && { echo '[BLOCKED] AI agents cannot merge PRs directly. Please review the PR and merge manually if approved.' >&2; exit 2; } || true

hooks.comment: Block --no-verify flag in git commands (bypasses quality gates)
Enforce version bump and CHANGELOG update on main commits and PR creation
Check for dead code before commits to main (golangci-lint)
Enforce code formatting (gofmt, goimports, prettier)
Ensure schema changes have migrations (Rule 9 and Rule 27)
Block direct database modifications (Rule 9 and Rule 27)
Block unauthorized markdown file creation
Enforce 500 LOC limit on source files
Block emoji characters in code and documentation
Enforce Container/Presentational pattern for React components
Track file edits for build checking
Remind to rebuild after build commands
hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command' | grep -q 'go build\|make build\|npm run build' && echo 'Build complete. Backend: ./bin/engineerdna | Frontend: Check localhost:3847' || true

hooks.comment: Validate critical patterns (security, anti-patterns)
Automatic build checking for Go errors
Post-work checklist reminder
hooks.command: printf '%s\n' 'Post-work checklist:' 'Backend (Go):' '  - go vet ./...' '  - staticcheck ./...' '  - go test ./...' '  - make build' 'Frontend (when added):' '  - cd frontend && npm run lint' '  - npm run typecheck' '  - npm run build' 'Always:' '  - git diff (review changes)'

hooks.comment: Environment verification on session start
hooks.command: printf '%s\n' 'Session started' "Directory: $(pwd)" "Branch: $(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo 'not a git repo')" '' 'Remember:' '- Pre-work: pwd, git status, go vet' '- Post-work: go vet, go test, make build (+ frontend checks when added)'
